name: My Angel
source:
As a criminal police officer, I am responsible for investigating a homicide case where a father allegedly killed his daughter before taking his own life. During the investigation, more unknown secrets gradually emerged. A man who claimed to be a 'priest' documented his process of manipulating women and engaging in sensationalistic murders. Unbeknownst to me, my daughter had also been in contact with this 'priest.' Having already lost my wife, I swear to use every means to protect my daughter. The fate of both myself and my daughter hangs in the balance, and I wonder if I can safeguard her effectively...

[From [url=https://wupuhuiqianren.itch.io/my-angel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
身为刑警，我负责调查一桩凶杀案：一名父亲据称杀害女儿后自杀。随着调查深入，更多不为人知的秘密逐渐浮出水面。一名自称“神父”的男子，记录了自己操纵女性、实施骇人凶杀的过程。而我毫不知情的是，我的女儿竟然也与这名“神父”有过接触。已经失去妻子的我，发誓不惜一切保护女儿。我与女儿的命运都悬于一线，而我真的能守护好她吗……

[摘自[url=https://wupuhuiqianren.itch.io/my-angel]itch.io[/url]]
